<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="
            http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0
            https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">

    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>3.5.0</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.juanesteban.tcc</groupId>
    <artifactId>financial-monolith</artifactId>
    <version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version>

    <name>financial-monolith</name>

    <description>
        Monolithic implementation for financial architecture benchmark
    </description>

    <properties>
        <java.version>21</java.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>

        <!-- REST -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- JPA -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- PostgreSQL -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
            <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Validation -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-validation</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Actuator -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Tests -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

    </dependencies>

    <build>

        <plugins>

            <plugin>

                <groupId>
                    org.springframework.boot
                </groupId>

                <artifactId>
                    spring-boot-maven-plugin
                </artifactId>

            </plugin>

            <plugin>

                <groupId>
                    org.jacoco
                </groupId>

                <artifactId>
                    jacoco-maven-plugin
                </artifactId>

                <version>
                    0.8.13
                </version>

                <executions>

                    <execution>

                        <goals>
                            <goal>
                                prepare-agent
                            </goal>
                        </goals>

                    </execution>


                    <execution>

                        <id>
                            jacoco-report
                        </id>

                        <phase>
                            verify
                        </phase>

                        <goals>
                            <goal>
                                report
                            </goal>
                        </goals>

                    </execution>

                </executions>

            </plugin>

        </plugins>

    </build>

</project>spring:

  application:
    name: financial-monolith

  datasource:
    url: ${SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL:jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/finance}
    username: ${SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME:finance}
    password: ${SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD:finance}

  jpa:
    hibernate:
      ddl-auto: update

    show-sql: true

    properties:
      hibernate:
        format_sql: true

server:
  port: 8080

management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: health,infopackage com.juanesteban.tcc.finance;

import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication;

@SpringBootApplication
public class FinancialMonolithApplication {

    public static void main(String[] args) {

        SpringApplication.run(
            FinancialMonolithApplication.class,
            args
        );

    }
}services:

  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: finance-monolith-postgres

    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: finance
      POSTGRES_USER: finance
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: finance
      TZ: UTC
      PGTZ: UTC

    ports:
      - "5433:5432"

    volumes:
      - finance_monolith_postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U finance -d finance"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10


  app:
    image: maven:3.9.9-eclipse-temurin-21
    container_name: finance-monolith-app

    working_dir: /workspace

    volumes:
      - ./financial-monolith:/workspace
      - finance_monolith_maven_cache:/root/.m2

    ports:
      - "8080:8080"

    environment:
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/finance
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: finance
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: finance
      TZ: UTC
      JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS: -Duser.timezone=UTC

    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

    command:
      - mvn
      - spring-boot:run

  postgres-test:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: finance-monolith-postgres-test

    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: finance_test
      POSTGRES_USER: finance_test
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: finance_test
      TZ: UTC
      PGTZ: UTC

    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U finance_test -d finance_test"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

content.text:
Implementação concluída; o build compila, mas não executei smoke tests em runtime.

**Arquivos criados** (em `financial-monolith/src/main/java/com/juanesteban/tcc/finance/`):
- `Entities.java`: `AppUser`, `Holding` e `Trade`.
- `Repositories.java`: os três repositórios JPA. O de usuário tem lock pessimista para evitar corrida em saldo e posição.
- `FinanceService.java`: cotações fixas, regras de compra e venda, portfólio e histórico. As operações são transacionais, então uma rejeição não altera saldo nem posição.
- `FinanceController.java`: os 6 endpoints do contrato, com tratamento de erros (400 para JSON inválido ou UUID malformado, 404 para usuário inexistente).

Não alterei `pom.xml`, `application.yml` nem `docker-compose.yml`.

**Comandos:**
- Não há `mvn` local, então rodei `docker run --rm maven:3.9.9-eclipse-temurin-21 mvn -q -DskipTests package` no workspace. Foi `docker run` avulso, sem `docker compose`.
- Depois apaguei o diretório `target` gerado.

**Erros:** nenhum. O build passou na primeira tentativa.

**Estado final:**
- A aplicação compila, mas ainda não foi subida nem testada contra o PostgreSQL. Isso fica com o orquestrador.
- Em requisição com vários problemas, a validação vem antes da checagem de usuário. Por exemplo, `shares <= 0` ou símbolo inválido retorna 400 mesmo que o usuário não exista. O contrato não define essa ordem.
